note: Independent re-audit against RFC 9494 Sections 3.1 and 4.1 ('If the LLGR capability is advertised, the Graceful Restart capability [RFC4724] MUST also be advertised') after splitting graceful-restart into short-lived and long-lived > family. parseLLGRCapValue requires capMap['graceful-restart'] to be a map, parseGRCapValue emits a non-empty code-64 payload ('0000' when short-lived is omitted, or header + tuples when present) for every peer with that container, and both share grCapabilityFor for peer/group precedence. Positive TestRFC9494_LLGRCapDeclaredWithGRCap asserts both code 71 and code 64 are declared for the same peer under configWithLLST. Negative TestRFC9494_NoLLGRCapWithoutGRContainer places long-lived > family outside graceful-restart and asserts neither code 71 nor code 64 is declared. Bounded to the plugin capability-declaration boundary; reactor OPEN framing is not asserted in these units. Note: in rfc/discrimination/rfc9494/RFC9494-3.1-1.json, the positive extractLLGRCapabilities revert record still carries prior producer-sha 5e2ede5080554e41 (vs current f3f24d396d6d7969) and must be renewed by main before ./le rfc check.
